test_date_filter_dropdown_opens.title: Verify the date filter dropdown opens on the page's date ranges

steps.action: Open Media and click the date filter.
steps.expected: The list opens and offers Today, Yesterday, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days and Custom, in that order.

test_date_filter_has_options.title: Verify the date filter dropdown has multiple filter options

steps.action: Open Media and open the date filter dropdown.
steps.expected: The dropdown offers at least three date ranges.

steps.action: Open Media, choose Last 7 Days, then choose Today.
steps.expected: The date filter reads Today again.

test_date_filter_last_7_days.title: Verify selecting 'Last 7 Days' date filter works

steps.action: Open Media and choose Last 7 Days.
steps.expected: The date filter reads Last 7 Days instead of Today.

test_grid_view_toggle_visible.title: Verify the view toggle starts in list view

steps.action: Open Media and read the view toggle.
steps.expected: The list (table) button reads pressed and the grid button does not.

test_view_toggle_area_present.title: Verify the view toggle offers exactly the list and grid buttons

steps.action: Open Media and read the view toggle group.
steps.expected: It holds a table button and a grid button, one of them pressed.

test_grid_view_switch_round_trip.title: Verify grid view can be activated and the list view comes back

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, switch to grid view and then back to list view.
steps.expected: The items move from one column into several and back into one; the pressed button follows.

test_tab_round_trip_all_to_clips.title: Verify switching from All to Clips and back works

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days, click the Clips tab, then click the All tab.
steps.expected: Clips is painted as selected after the first click, the type row's All after the second, and the date filter still reads Last 30 Days.

test_tab_round_trip_folders_to_shared.title: Verify switching from Folders to Shared with me and back works

steps.action: Click Media in the left sidebar, open the date filter, and choose Last 30 Days.
steps.expected: The date filter reads Last 30 Days.

steps.action: Click the Folders tab, then Shared with me, then Folders again.
steps.expected: Each tab is painted as selected in turn and the date filter still reads Last 30 Days.

test_core_tabs_accessible.title: Verify the core media tabs can be selected in turn

steps.action: Click Media in the left sidebar, open the date filter, and choose Last 30 Days.
steps.expected: The date filter reads Last 30 Days.

steps.action: Click the All, My Media, Shared with me, Clips, and Folders tabs in turn.
steps.expected: Each tab is painted as selected after its click, and each shows items or its empty state.

test_search_input_visible.title: Verify the search field on the Media page

steps.action: Open Media and set the date filter to Last 30 Days.
steps.expected: The search field is shown, empty, with the placeholder "Search by title, tags, sites, etc.".

test_search_no_results.title: Verify searching for nonexistent text shows the empty state

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days and search for zzzznonexistent999xyz.
steps.expected: No items are listed and the page says "No results found for selected criteria".

test_search_clear_and_retry.title: Verify clearing search and searching again works

steps.action: Click Media in the left sidebar, open the date filter, and choose Last 30 Days.
Type the first item's name in the search field and press Enter.
steps.expected: The list narrows to items carrying that name.

steps.action: Clear the field and press Enter.
steps.expected: The full list comes back with the same number of items as before.

test_media_page_after_refresh.title: Verify the Media page loads correctly after a browser refresh

steps.action: On the Media page, refresh the browser and open Media again.
steps.expected: The address ends in /media and the date filter reads Today, its default.
